entry.notes: representation gap unsafe-integer of the js table (registry/gaps/js.toml): @stellar/stellar-sdk xdr hyper, unsigned hyper as number (IEEE-754 binary64). a number holds every integer only up to 2^53-1; 9007199254740993 written as a number literal is already 9007199254740992 before any sdk code runs, so a 64-bit id or amount given as a number can name a different value than the caller wrote. 17.2.1 MuxedAccount takes the id as text only; Operation offer ids take numbers. 17.4.0 refuses offer id numbers above 2^53-1 (offerId must be a non-negative safe integer)
